Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.1: God as the CREATION

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers God as the CREATION, part of GOD’S in PP2 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What does God b) Sing simple songs on God identify things that God provide for us?
